method: headless Chrome (SwiftShader WebGL 2) over CDP against the hosted SuperSplat viewer; Esc stops the camera animation, the viewer DOM overlays are hidden, mouse drags and wheel orbit between frames. Frames 3 and 4 come from an earlier pass where the overlays were still visible; the viewer control strip is cropped off (sips centre crop 800 → 690 px).

frames.frame-3: orbit right (earlier pass, bottom strip cropped)
frames.frame-4: lower angle (earlier pass, bottom strip cropped)
